Disabling unused ports and services.
The location of the switch in the data center.
The type of cables connected to the switch.
feedbacks: The colour is irrelevant.
Disabling unused ports minimises the attack area.
The location is not relevant to security.
The cable type is dictated by application.
questions.explanation: Disabling unused ports and services reduces the attack surface of the switch, making it more difficult for unauthorized individuals to gain access.

questions.question: According to TIA-942, what is the recommended minimum level of documentation for a data center's electrical system?

A photo is not enough detail.

Implementing hot aisle/cold aisle containment.

Containment improves airflow and efficiency.
questions.explanation: Positioning server racks close together without considering airflow patterns can create hotspots and reduce cooling efficiency.

The brand of the treatment chemicals.
feedbacks: Cost is less important than effectiveness.
This will prevent damage to equipment.
The color is not relevant.
The brand is not the primary consideration.
questions.explanation: A water treatment program must be able to prevent corrosion, scaling, and biological growth to ensure the longevity and efficiency of the cooling system.

questions.question: According to TIA-942, what is the recommended minimum level of maintenance for a data center's uninterruptible power supply (UPS) system?

Replacing the batteries every 10 years.

Visual inspection is not enough.
Regular maintenance ensures reliability.
Batteries should be replaced much more frequently.
questions.explanation: Regular testing and maintenance of all UPS components are essential for ensuring the UPS system's reliability and preventing unexpected failures.

questions.question: Which of the following is the MOST effective method for preventing data breaches in a data center, according to TIA-942 guidelines?

Implementing a strong data encryption and access control policy.

Physical security is only part of the solution.
This would render the data center useless.
questions.explanation: A strong data encryption and access control policy ensures that sensitive data is protected from unauthorized access, even in the event of a security breach.

The system's ability to provide early warning of a fire.
The cost of the system.

The brand is not the primary consideration.
